mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates (below 0.5%) compress equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate valuation.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in federal funds rate above 0.25% signals monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.25%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rates combined with high unemployment (FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and UNRATE > 7.5%) indicates extended monetary accommodation, boosting S&P 500 returns over 20 days through compressed discount rates.
failure_condition: The joint condition FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and UNRATE > 7.5% fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >60% of cases, or interaction term coefficient p>0.05 in regression.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 7.5%) signals economic weakness and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST above 850.0) indicate strong consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 850.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 850.0 signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as economic growth slows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 850.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST < 850.0) and industrial production (INDPRO < 99.0) indicate broad economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint condition HOUST < 850.0 and INDPRO < 99.0 fails to produce negative 20-day returns in >60% of cases, or interaction term coefficient p>0.05 in regression.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 99.0 signals manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate profits and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 99.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
